title: Te Kupu Whakamana o te Kōpū
intro: I roto i ngā rūma wahangu o te ngākau i whakatapua ki te Atua, i whakaarohia he oati tapu. Ko te kaupapa o tēnei oati he oranga kāore anō kia manawa, ā, mā tōna whakatutukitanga e whakarerekē te huarahi o te taonga tuku iho wairua ake ake. Eke atu ki te mea ngaro o te wairua nāna nei te oati e tangi tonu ana i te ao mutunga kore.
clues: I noho ahau i roto i tētahi whare e mōhiotia ana mō tōna karakia, ā, i hiahia ahau ki tētahi taonga hei whakatata atu i ahau ki a Allah.
I whakarite kawenata nui ahau ki tōku Ariki mō ngā mea i huna i roto i ahau, me te oati ka whakatapua katoatia e ahau ki tāna mahi.
I te taenga mai o te wā o te huraina, kāore i tumanakohia te mea i tae mai ki ahau, engari i tukua e ahau te mea nei ki te Mana-Mārama.
I tapaina e au taku tamaiti he ingoa e tohu ana i te aroha, ā, i inoi ahau kia tiakina ia me āna uri i te mea kua kanga.
I whakanohoia taku tamaiti ki te wāhi tapu, i raro i te mana tiaki o tētahi poropiti nō te uri o Arona.
I mōhiotia taku tamāhine mō tōna parakore, ā, i whiriwhiria ia i runga ake i ngā wāhine katoa, ā, i muri mai ka noho ko ia hei whaea o tētahi poropiti nui, ahakoa kāore i pāngia.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te wahine a Imran
Te whaea o Musa
Te wahine a Parao
Te wahine a Al-Aziz
Ko te whaea o Īha

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: He kupu taurangi ki te whakatapua i tana tamaiti kāore anō kia whānau ki te temepara
He whakamātautau i te manawanui i roto i te mate roa
He haerenga ki tētahi whenua tawhiti mō te whakapono
He pakanga ki tētahi kīngi nanakia
He kai whakamiharo mai i te rangi
trial.answer: He kupu taurangi ki te whakatapua i tana tamaiti kāore anō kia whānau ki te temepara

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Ko te tamaiti ko Maryam tōna ingoa
Te tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
Te kuao kau koura
Te puna o Zamzam
Te āka a Noa
location.answer: Ko te tamaiti ko Maryam tōna ingoa

outcome.label: Hua
options: I manakohia tana tamaiti e Allah, ā, i tipu ake i raro i te manaakitanga poropiti.
I riro tana tamaiti hei poropiti, ā, i whiwhi ia i tētahi karaipiture
I whakaarahia tana tamaiti ki te rangi
Nāna i hanga te whare tapu e tana tamaiti
I whakawhiwhia tana tamaiti ki te whakaaro nui me te taonga nui
outcome.answer: I manakohia tana tamaiti e Allah, ā, i tipu ake i raro i te manaakitanga poropiti.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
